decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom draws directly on the firm's decades of dosimetry and scanning-phantom expertise and is only now being released more widely, so management will keep it while it learns from early clinical feedback.
Small volume ionization chambers are core dosimetry know-how where the firm's accredited calibration and physics staff can interpret results and refine the design, so keeping it is well supported.
This chamber builds on the same deep detector knowledge base and serves the growing small-field dosimetry demand, making withdrawal one year after launch unlikely.
A standard clinical chamber line with several models is central to the established business and fully absorbed into existing calibration and service capabilities.
The relative dosimetry chamber complements the firm's water phantoms and QA workflows, using closely related knowledge, so it fits the integrated platform strategy.
Thimble chambers are a long-standing core competence with long regulatory and clinical life cycles, so the firm will keep it on the market.
